title: 電波工学
subtitle: Microwave Engineering
educationalGoal: With the goal of acquiring and utilizing basic knowledge about information and communication, in this course, learn about energy transfer by electromagnetic waves and radiation of electromagnetic waves. Understand the characteristics of the antenna and perform basic calculations necessary for design. In addition, learn about the behavior of electromagnetic waves in the medium and at the boundaries, and understand the form of radio wave propagation. Furthermore, learn about basic radio transmission and reception and perform basic calculation of C / N ratio.
advice: The class covers the following items. 1. Electromagnetic waves and their applications 2. Transmission of energy by electromagnetic waves 3. Radiation of electromagnetic waves 4. Electromagnetic wave behavior at media boundaries 5. Radio wave propagation in the atmosphere 7. Transmitter and receiver 8. Radar system
requiredKnowledge: 1. Before studying this subject, it is necessary to master and understand "Electromagnetics I", "Electromagnetics II", and "Electromagnetics III". 2. Be sure to answer and submit your own exercises in each chapter. 3. Understand and store definitions and meanings of technical terms properly. 4. Review the contents of the text and slides carefully in the class to clearly distinguish what you have understood and what you can not do, and ask questions

activityGoals.body: Understand the concept and role of radio waves and explain the mechanism applied.
Understand the nature and propagation of electromagnetic waves and perform basic calculations.
Understand the concept of antenna and calculate basic characteristics.
Understand the behavior of electromagnetic waves and explain typical concepts.
Understand the basics of radio wave propagation and explain typical concepts.
Understand the transmission and reception of radio waves and can calculate the basic C / N ratio.
